title: When Top-K Misses the Decision: Tool-Call Drift in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2607.07050v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Top-$K$ teacher logits make on-policy distillation tractable, but retained teacher mass does not certify student-relative gradient fidelity. We study routed, two-teacher tool-use distillation. In a frozen Qwen3.5-9B audit, the tool teacher ranks the entry token first on 500 tool prompts, and top-32 reinforces it in every matched pair. The response teacher's top-32 instead retains 99.99\% mass yet contains the same token on only 0.4\% of 500 response prompts; student-aware support restores the coordinate in all matched pairs and nearly matches full-vocabulary descent. On the tool route, top-32 preserves the reinforcing direction but substantially attenuates its full-vocabulary magnitude despite mass displayed as 1.000000. Matched restoration connects the response-side omission to behavior: restoring the entry coordinate at every supervised response position lowers full-generation over-calling from $14.2 \pm 2.1\%$ to $3.7 \pm 0.5\%$ a

translated_title: 当Top-K错过决策：多教师在线策略蒸馏中的工具调用漂移
translated_abstract: 摘要：Top-$K$教师logits使得在线策略蒸馏变得可行，但保留的教师概率质量并不能保证学生相对梯度的保真度。我们研究了路由式双教师工具使用蒸馏。在冻结的Qwen3.5-9B审计中，工具教师在500个工具提示上将入口令牌排名第一，top-32在每对匹配样本中强化了该令牌。相反，响应教师的top-32保留了99.99%的概率质量，但在500个响应提示中仅0.4%包含相同令牌；学生感知的支持集恢复了所有匹配对中的坐标，并几乎与全词汇表下降相匹配。在工具路由上，top-32保留了强化方向，但显著减弱了其全词汇表幅度，尽管显示的质量为1.000000。匹配恢复将响应侧遗漏与行为联系起来：在每个监督响应位置恢复入口坐标，将全生成过度调用率从$14.2 \pm 2.1\%$降至$3.7 \pm 0.5\%$。
tldr: 本研究揭示了多教师在线策略蒸馏中Top-K采样导致的“工具调用漂移”问题，并提出通过学生感知的支持集恢复被遗漏的令牌坐标，从而显著降低过度调用率。
en_tdlr: This study reveals "tool-call drift" caused by Top-K sampling in multi-teacher on-policy distillation, and proposes restoring omitted token coordinates via student-aware support sets, significantly reducing over-calling rates.
